display.purpose: Hero headline, legal-page titles and the 404 title only; capped at 14-18ch. Every 'i' carries the green tittle.

headline.purpose: Section titles in the left column of a section head; green tittles and a green closing period.

title.purpose: Service names, plans heading, legal section headings.

title-small.purpose: Process stage names and live register product names.

lede.purpose: Section-head descriptions (38ch), hero lede (50ch), about statements (54ch); Ink 2.

body.purpose: Running text; legal prose at 68ch in Ink 2.

label.purpose: Form labels, plan column heads, footer heads (600); nav links (500); captions and metadata (400, Ink 3). Sentence case.

code.purpose: Literal code only: the footer commit hash (0.8125rem) and inline code in legal prose (0.85em). The one exception to the one-family rule.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Form field focus only, paired with a green-ink border.

shadows.name: node-unlit
shadows.purpose: Unlit process node before the rail enters view (only when reveal is active); never a resting style.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Easing for every state transition, the reveal, the theme reveal and the sparkle.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Link colour, input border, theme toggle colour.

motion.name: state-base
motion.purpose: Button fill and press nudge, register row fill and arrow shift, tooltip, header border, mobile menu, table-of-contents dot.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, translateY(14px) -> none, 700ms ease-out, delay var(--stagger) * 70ms; IntersectionObserver threshold 0.15, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0, one-shot
motion.purpose: Rows print in once like log entries. Enabled only through html.reveal (IO present, motion allowed); a 2.5s safety net removes it if the script fails.

motion.name: rail-fill
motion.value: scale(0) -> scale(1) along one continuous track, 1400ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), 150ms delay; nodes 350ms, delay 150ms + i * 420ms
motion.purpose: Time-based, one-shot fill of the process rail when it enters view; nodes light in sequence. Shown filled without reveal.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.value: View Transition; clip-path circle(0 -> farthest corner) from the toggle centre on ::view-transition-new(root), 650ms ease-out
motion.purpose: The new theme spreads from the button. Skipped (instant swap) without support or with reduced motion.

motion.name: orb-morph
motion.purpose: Sun to moon: mask bite slides in, disc scales 1.55, rays rotate -45deg, scale 0.4 and fade.

motion.name: spark-burst
motion.value: 12 four-point stars, 1.6s ease-out, staggered delays 0-0.99s, 2 iterations; hover replay throttled to 1.8s
motion.purpose: Burst from the hero's closing dot on load and hover. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms; smooth scroll off
motion.purpose: Global floor: every authored motion collapses to its end state.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Form and plan columns go two-up.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Menu toggle below; inline nav at and above.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Section heads, services, plans, process, about, contact and footer split.

narrative.overview:
Invntio reads like a changelog and a deploy status board, not a pitch. Every surface is a ledger: an ink rule opens a panel, hairlines separate its rows, and a small set of authored marks says what state each row is in. The page is flat. One family of type sets everything, flush left on a 7/5 split grid, and a single committed jump in scale (the display headline) carries the hierarchy.

Density is moderate and the tone is matter-of-fact. Content is laid out as registers and ruled lists (live products, services, what a plan includes, the four engagement stages, contact details) so that a visitor can scan what is real without decoration getting in the way. The brand green is scarce because it is a signal. It is the dot of the wordmark, carried into the type as the tittle on every "i" in a heading and the period that closes a section title, and it is the live state: a product that answered at deploy time, progress along the process rail, the build that is running now.

The record has two printings. By day it is a near-white technical sheet. At night ("technical sheet at night") it is the same sheet as a blueprint: a dark ground with a faint 24px grid, light ink, and the same rules, marks and layout. The theme follows the system preference until the visitor chooses, and the choice is remembered. On paper it is always black ink on white.

The world rejects the centered gradient hero, blurred colour blobs and the icon-card grid. Depth, containers and emphasis come from rules and type, never from boxes or shadows.
keyCharacteristics: A flat ground (near-white by day, near-black blueprint by night) with ink text and hairline rules; no cards and no drop shadows.
Panels open with a 1px ink top rule; rows are divided by 1px hairlines.
Schibsted Grotesk only, with a large display step and quiet everything else.
Three authored SVG state marks (live, included, excluded) as the whole state vocabulary.
Brand green is the wordmark's dot and the live signal: tittles, closing periods, the live mark, the rail, the build dot.
Motion is sparse and one-shot: rows print in once, the rail fills once, the hero's closing dot bursts once. All of it is removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Live Green is a dot or a line: the wordmark's dot as it recurs in type (tittles, closing periods, the hero sparkle), a live or current state (live mark, build dot, active table-of-contents dot), rail progress, and selection. At night it also fills the primary action. It is never a background wash, a border, an icon colour or running text.

rules.name: The Accent Action Rule
rules.body: Anything the visitor presses as a primary action takes the accent fill: Release Green with white text by day, Live Green with Night Label text at night. Both pairings pass WCAG AA; never pair Live Green with white text.

rules.name: The Ink Icon Rule
rules.body: Pictograms, the included mark and list bullets are Ink or Ink 3. Green dots appear only where they mean live or current.

rules.name: The Two Printings Rule
rules.body: Dark is the same sheet, not a different design. Every role has a night value; layout, rules, marks, type and motion do not change between themes. The blueprint grid is the only thing the night adds.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk sets every word. Hierarchy comes from weight, size and ink level, never from a second typeface. The only exception is literal code (a commit hash, an inline identifier), which is set in the system monospace because it is code, not voice.

rules.name: The Committed Scale Rule
rules.body: Display is the only oversized step. Everything below Headline stays within 0.875 to 1.75rem, so the jump to the headline reads as a decision. The micro sizes (0.75 to 0.8125rem) are reserved for the status tooltip, register kind tags and code.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, headings and buttons use sentence case with normal tracking. There are no uppercase tracked labels.

rules.name: The Tittle Rule
rules.body: Every "i" in a display or headline heading (and the plans title) carries a green tittle. The real glyph is recoloured with a hard two-tone text fill: Live Green above 33.5% of the line box and Ink below, measured to fall in Schibsted Grotesk's gap between dot and stem. The stop is hard, so it reads as a coloured dot, never as gradient text. Section titles also close on a green period. In print the tittle reverts to plain ink. Do not reuse the technique for any other effect.

rules.name: The Ruled Panel Rule
rules.body: There are no cards. A panel is an ink top rule and hairline row dividers on the page ground, with no fill, border box or shadow. Form inputs and quiet buttons are the one surface fill, because a field has to look like a field. The consent bar follows the same rule: ground fill, ink top rule.

rules.name: The Flat-Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover states change fill, border or ink colour. Nothing lifts or casts a shadow. The only movement on press is the 1px nudge of a button.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Print is always black ink on white paper, whatever the screen theme. Site chrome (nav, theme and menu buttons, consent bar, legal tabs and table of contents, footer navigation and links) is hidden, the header becomes static with a black rule under the wordmark, and every reveal is shown. Green marks print in Signal Ink Green so they survive on paper.

dos: **Do** open every panel with a 1px Ink top rule and divide its rows with 1px Hairline on the page ground, in both themes.
**Do** use the accent fill for every primary action: Release Green (#155c40) with white text by day, Live Green with Night Label text at night.
**Do** express state with the three authored marks (live, included, excluded) and keep their meanings fixed across surfaces.
**Do** give every role a night value and keep layout, type, rules and marks identical between themes.
**Do** set the green tittle on every "i" of display and headline headings with the hard 33.5% split, and close section titles with a green period.
**Do** keep icons and list markers in Ink or Ink 3.
**Do** set every level in Schibsted Grotesk, and let the fluid display step (700, -0.035em) be the only oversized type.
**Do** build layouts on the asymmetric 7/5 split, flush left, and collapse to one column at 900 to 1000px.
**Do** make motion one-shot and remove it under reduced motion: reveal once, fill the rail once, burst the hero dot on load and hover only.
